faq.q: What does the name Aalim mean?
What is the origin of the name Aalim?
What language does the name Aalim come from?
faq.a: Aalim is used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian, Pashto.

faq.q: Is Aalim a boy's name or a girl's name?
faq.a: Aalim is used as a male name.

faq.q: How is Aalim written in Arabic and Urdu?
faq.a: Aalim is written عالم in Arabic and عالم in Urdu, and आलिम in Devanagari.

faq.q: What is the linguistic root of Aalim?
faq.a: The root of Aalim is ع-ل-م (ʿ-l-m).

faq.q: What is the etymology of Aalim?
faq.a: Arabic ʿālim, active participle of ʿalima, 'to know'.

faq.q: Does Aalim appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: Not a Qur'anic personal name; ʿālim, 'one who knows', is Arabic vocabulary from the root ʿ-l-m.
ʿĀlim means 'scholar, learned person', the active participle of ʿalima, 'to know'.

faq.q: What is the numerology or lucky number of Aalim?
faq.a: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aalim total 18, reducing to 9. Number 9 is traditionally associated with its own character. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.

faq.q: What are the common spelling variants of Aalim?
faq.a: Aalim appears with variants and alternative spellings such as Alim, Aalam.

faq.q: Which names are related to Aalim?
faq.a: Names sharing form or root with Aalim include Aalima, Aalam.

faq.q: Is Aalim the same as Aalam?
faq.a: The letters are identical (عالم). Read ʿālim it means 'scholar'; read ʿālam it means 'world'.

faq.q: Where is the name Aalim used today?
faq.a: Aalim is used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian, Pashto naming communities. No verified registration statistics are published for it, so no popularity score is asserted.
